g.title: public.gift_cards
g.text: Balance maintained by triggers: created/loaded by a gift_card SALE item, decremented by a gift_card PAYMENT. Balance can never go negative (trigger).

g.title: public.organizations
g.text: Tenant root. Single row today; every domain table hangs off organization_id for future multi-tenancy.

g.title: public.clients
g.text: Spa clients (no auth accounts). no_show_count is maintained by trigger from appointment status changes. flags is an extensible jsonb for operational booleans (requires_card_on_file).
Operational booleans, extendable without migrations. Known keys: requires_card_on_file
Stripe Customer id (cus_...). Created lazily by the setup-intent route on first card save. Single platform Stripe account; a future Connect retrofit would add an account dimension here.

g.title: public.transaction_items
g.text: Line items with name/price SNAPSHOTS (catalog edits never rewrite sold history). kind=service carries appointment + staff attribution; kind=tip carries staff attribution for payroll reads; kind=discount is negative; kind=gift_card is a liability sale, excluded from revenue reporting.

g.title: public.payments
g.text: How each transaction settled. Multiple rows = split tender ("$80 gift card + rest on card"). card_external = charged on the spa's existing physical terminal and recorded here; in-app charging arrives with Stripe (4b).
Set on method=stripe_card rows (pi_...). The refund route calls stripe.refunds.create against this. The sync charge flow guarantees it: ledger rows are written only after the PaymentIntent succeeds.
